MessageTypes.Label: BAT DISCHARGE
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 dark, 1 lit, 2 lit and blinking at 1 Hz. PMDG: FSUIPC offset 0x64A0

MessageTypes.Label: TR UNIT
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 dark, 1 lit, 2 lit and blinking at 1 Hz. PMDG: FSUIPC offset 0x64A1

MessageTypes.Label: ELEC
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 dark, 1 lit, 2 lit and blinking at 1 Hz. PMDG: FSUIPC offset 0x64A2

MessageTypes.Label: Display top line (DC AMPS, CPS FREQ)
MessageTypes.Description: $ is shown as-is: 12 characters, three right-aligned 4-character fields. PMDG: FSUIPC string offset 0x64BC, 13 bytes (ELEC_MeterDisplayTop) -- the sim already applies the selectors. A line that arrives short has lost trailing blanks and is padded with spaces on the right.

MessageTypes.Label: Display bottom line (DC VOLTS, AC AMPS, AC VOLTS)
MessageTypes.Description: $ is shown as-is: 12 characters, three right-aligned 4-character fields. PMDG: FSUIPC string offset 0x64C9, 13 bytes (ELEC_MeterDisplayBottom) -- the sim already applies the selectors. A line that arrives short has lost trailing blanks and is padded with spaces on the right.

MessageTypes.Label: DC meter selector position (optional)
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 STBY PWR, 1 BAT BUS, 2 BAT, 3 AUX BAT, 4 TR1, 5 TR2, 6 TR3, 7 TEST -- named under the lamps. PMDG: FSUIPC offset 0x64A3. Leave unbound to hide

MessageTypes.Label: AC meter selector position (optional)
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 STBY PWR, 1 GRD PWR, 2 GEN1, 3 APU GEN, 4 GEN2, 5 INV, 6 TEST -- named under the lamps. PMDG: FSUIPC offset 0x64A4. Leave unbound to hide

MessageTypes.Label: Set backlight brightness
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 16-255, applied while the panel is lit (lower values are raised to 16: turning the panel off is bus power's job). Defaults to 255, or the Additional config value set on the device

MessageTypes.Label: Night dimming
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 1 drops lamp luminance and removes the glow, 0 restores full brightness

MessageTypes.Label: Lamp test
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 1 lights every lamp, 0 returns to the live state

MessageTypes.Label: Run self test
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 1 cycles the built-in demo states; the next lamp message ends it

MessageTypes.Label: Bus power (panel lit)
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 0 keeps the panel dark, 1 lets it light. For binding a bus VOLTAGE directly (anything from 0.5 up counts as powered). The profiles use 107 instead, because the Connector's tests send 0 here and darken the panel

MessageTypes.Label: Bus unpowered (panel dark)
MessageTypes.Description: $ = 1 keeps the panel dark (the bus that feeds these lights is off), 0 lets it light. The inverse of 105, so that the 0 which Test Mode and the end of every test send leaves the panel lit (a row's own Test sends 1, which shows the dark, unpowered state). PMDG: FSUIPC 0x64D8 (DC BATT BUS) with Transformation if($=0,1,0)
